## What this issue is about
This issue focuses on updating the system requirements for the Plone Aurora project documentation. The current requirements may be outdated, particularly around the versions of Node.js and NVM (Node Version Manager).

## What needs to be done
1. Update the documentation at [System Requirements](https://plone-aurora.readthedocs.io/get-started/system-requirements.html#nvm) to reflect the latest version of NVM (0.40.8) and the required Node.js version (22.22.0 or higher).
2. Consider a script that checks for the latest release tags automatically, similar to an existing script in the icalendar project.

## Helpful background
Outdated documentation can lead to confusion and errors when setting up the environment. Currently, users may experience warnings or errors if they do not have the specified versions installed, as noted in the issue.

## Good first steps
1. Review the existing documentation linked above and note the changes needed.
2. Familiarize yourself with how to update documentation in the Plone Aurora project.
3. If interested, explore the script mentioned for checking release versions. This might involve learning a bit about Python and GitHub API usage.
4. You can ask questions or seek clarification in the issue thread if any part is unclear.
